_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 14% breaker rate and flat 30d/funding tape make HOLD the skilled base-rate call until Fear & Greed or flows force a rung change.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on forward phase but inflow print does not contradict caution
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 55-62, 30d momentum near 50, funding flat, price range-bound without ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed >63 with momentum/funding lift (Hope) or <54 with CVD rollover and range break (Complacency)
